message.content:
Go to **Microsoft account sign-in** at **account.microsoft.com** and enter your email or phone number, then your password.[1][2]

If you **don’t have an account**, choose **Create an account** on the sign-in page.[2][4]

If you **can’t sign in**, Microsoft says to use its sign-in helper tool or Contact Support through the account help page.[2]
